## Code Review

This pull request adds several new model configuration files for GSM8K evaluations and updates the nightly test lists. Several referenced configuration files are missing from the PR, including DeepSeek-R1-TP.yaml and those in the moe-refactor directory, which will cause CI failures. Additionally, the 120B parameter Nemotron model is incorrectly categorized in the small evaluation suite and should be moved to the large suite.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The configuration file `DeepSeek-R1-TP.yaml` is referenced here but is not included in the pull request. This will cause the evaluation pipeline to fail with a file-not-found error.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

There are several issues with these entries:

1. **Missing Files**: The following referenced files are not provided in this pull request: `moe-refactor/Llama-4-Scout-BF16-triton.yaml`, `moe-refactor/Mixtral-8x7B-BF16-triton.yaml`, and `Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4.yaml`.
2. **Misplaced Model**: `Nemotron-3-Super-120B` is a 120B parameter model. Given its size, it should likely be categorized under `models-nightly-large.txt` rather than the `small` evaluation suite to ensure appropriate resource allocation during testing.
